== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] fresh [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]], hulled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Coffee Liqueur|coffee liqueur]]
* 3 tbsp dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt
* ¾ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

== Procedure ==
#Melt butter in your largest stainless steel [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium heat. Add strawberries and cook until deeply browned. Remove and keep warm.
#[[Cookbook:Deglazing|Deglaze]] pan with rum and ignite. Stir to dissolve browned bits.
#Add remaining ingredients, and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] until reduced by ⅓.
#Add strawberries, reduce heat to low, and cook ½ hour.
#Remove pan from heat and serve.
